title: knowledge(upgrade): clarify DataTransfer defaults and bypass safety
summary: Upgrade guidance now clarifies that DataTransfer should be used regardless of record count and that skipping validation is only safe when the correct business logic is maintained, not just because a field is new.
key_points: Removes misleading 300,000-record threshold for DataTransfer usage
Emphasizes that new fields alone do not justify bypassing validation or triggers
Requires supported tables, correct filters, and preservation of business logic
Replaces opaque Base App samples with self-contained examples
Cites measured performance data from Microsoft Learn rather than unsourced claims
